content.text: Struggling to sell digital products in regions where platforms like Stripe and PayPal are unavailable? Your options are limited, but there’s a way to break free from these constraints. Digital creators in countries like Nigeria, Ghana, and Venezuela can leverage crypto payment solutions to build a robust online store. This guide compares the conventional options against sovereign stacks, revealing the hidden trade-offs that could impact your earnings.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/everything-you-need-know-about-automated-digital-product-10. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.
content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Start digital

Gumroad and similar platforms offer easy setups but come with hefty fees. For every sale, Gumroad takes a 10% cut, which can significantly eat into your profits. In contrast, NOWPayments charges only 0.5%, allowing you to retain more revenue. While Gumroad might appeal with its user-friendly interface, its cost structure can leave creators with far less in their pockets. Sovereign stacks built with COREMERCH allow you to own your [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/full-infrastructure-guide-kyc-payment-gateways-digital-sellers-3|infrastructure]] and keep the majority of your earnings, making it a more sustainable choice for serious creators.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Platforms like Gumroad, PayPal, and Stripe often deny access to creators in many African and South American countries, effectively locking them out of e-commerce opportunities. This is a serious limitation for digital creators who want to reach global audiences. On the other hand, COREMERCH's sovereign solutions do not discriminate based on location. You can deploy a digital commerce stack regardless of your country's restrictions. This opens up new avenues for creators who have faced financial isolation due to these platform barriers.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

When selling digital products, speed and cost matter. Traditional platforms can take several days to process payments and disburse funds, while NOWPayments verifies transactions almost instantly. This means you get paid faster and can reinvest in your business more quickly. Additionally, consider that with 100 sales per month on a $97 product, the fee [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-difference-between-choices-selling-digital-products-without-12|COREMERCH guide to difference]]-between-choices-selling-presets-without-stripe-13|The Real]] between Gumroad and NOWPayments retains $921 for you. Those savings can be crucial for scaling your operations or launching new products.
Keep 99.5% of your earnings with NOWPayments.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

With conventional platforms, you remain dependent on their services, which can change without notice. In contrast, using COREMERCH’s infrastructure gives you complete ownership of your setup. You control the backend logic with Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, automating delivery processes efficiently. This means when a customer makes a purchase, they receive their product immediately without relying on third-party systems. Such automation not only improves the customer experience but also minimizes the risk of revenue loss.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

Choosing the right architecture depends on your specific needs. If you’re looking for a quick solution with minimal setup, the Sovereign Starter Stack might suit you. However, if you desire more features and a scalable approach, the Complete Builder Kit offers everything you need. It provides you with all six blueprints and seven templates, making it easier to build, deploy, and scale your digital commerce stack effectively. Analyze your sales volume and long-term goals before making a decision.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

The fastest path to your first sovereign digital product sale is a three-step process. First, create a NOWPayments account — configure your wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as starting points, generate your API key, and set the webhook endpoint URL. Second, choose your stack: Stack 01 uses GitHub Pages plus Google Apps Script and takes most creators four to six hours following the Sovereign Blueprint at $47; Stack 02 uses Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase and is deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours with the Edge Commerce Stack at $197. Third, upload your product files, set your prices in USD, and run a complete mainnet test transaction before promoting.
Own your infrastructure. Don’t rent it.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Digital creators selling ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, and beats often reach this infrastructure question after hitting payout restrictions or platform policy problems on Gumroad, Payhip, or Lemon Squeezy. The difference with a sovereign stack is structural: there is no platform relationship to manage, no content policy to comply with, and no payout schedule to wait on. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys the complete infrastructure in 48 hours under your own accounts. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents the build process for creators who prefer to self-deploy. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Start by selecting the right sovereign stack that fits your needs. Deploy your hosting on Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages for free. Set up the backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Integrate NOWPayments for straightforward crypto payment processing. Load your first products and configure automated delivery with Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Test the system to ensure everything functions seamlessly before launching.
